body:
GREG, 2026-11-12 about 00:39Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #966, message df510c04), answering Fable's proposal #965 (B). Verbatim: „Tak. Zdalny test jest równowazny.”
Meaning, as relayed by Asistant: a remote test result counts the same as a local one, provided it is bound to the exact code (commit/tree) and to the right criterion. A remote FOCUSED PASS may satisfy the matching acceptance-evaluation criterion, including the evaluation start preflight and test-bound criteria. Landing still needs the full gate under the existing requirements. Coordinate through Engram w-180d6f507470 and TermAl K3 w-48c4a207f226; no needless local repeats.
Applied (Engram::Fable): this supersedes the "focused stays author evidence only" line in rules-greg-equivalent-gate-hosts-2026-10-28 and in w-180d's acceptance, for evaluation and verification use only. The landing_gate purpose is unchanged: a remote FULL with equal before and after fingerprints. Until w-180d and K3 ship, the host still refuses remote-only evidence. Interim: run locally only the tests a criterion names, never fmt or Clippy for credit, and never a FULL.
